audited_project_source.finding: The current gate can validate only the official Base and post-trained checkpoints. Neither is an abliterated Trigger-2 target candidate. They remain useful matched controls, but this gate cannot satisfy the Trigger-2 target-model constraint or select a target winner.
audited_project_source.revision_reason: A structurally exact non-abliterated checkpoint must not silently satisfy an abliterated-target requirement merely because its revision/weights/tokenizer hashes are well bound.

external_current_availability_inputs.observed: Repository currently presents itself as an Apache-2.0 abliterated derivative of Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B and exposes Transformers/Safetensors artifacts.
external_current_availability_inputs.caveat: The visible README commit and model-card evaluation claims do not by themselves freeze or attest the exact weight/tokenizer bytes Clay would load.

external_current_availability_inputs.observed: Repository currently presents itself as an abliterated derivative of Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B; its card reports refusal/KL metrics.
external_current_availability_inputs.caveat: Self-reported refusal/KL numbers are not Clay evaluation evidence and cannot select a winner. Exact immutable checkpoint/tokenizer byte identity is not bound by this audit.

external_current_availability_inputs.observed: Repository currently presents itself as an Apache-2.0 abliterated Qwen3.5-0.8B derivative and exposes a roughly 1.75 GB Safetensors weight artifact plus tokenizer/config files.
external_current_availability_inputs.caveat: Current repository existence and an abbreviated visible history identifier are insufficient for exact immutable byte binding.

material_findings.finding: The existing exact checkpoint gate has no abliterated target candidate and therefore cannot prove compliance with the Trigger-2 model-target constraint.
material_findings.required_successor: Separate TARGET from CONTROL roles. Require every TARGET to be an explicitly abliterated candidate with immutable repository revision plus exact downloaded weight/tokenizer/chat-template/config digests before matched pilot eligibility. Keep official Base/post-trained checkpoints as controls only.

material_findings.finding: A repository name/tag/model card saying abliterated is source metadata, not proof that the exact bytes later consumed by the loader are those inspected candidate bytes.
material_findings.required_successor: Bind candidate repository revision, file inventory/digests and loader-consumed byte identity. Unknown or mutable main-branch identity remains unresolved.

material_findings.finding: Abliteration/refusal reduction is a target property, not the sole optimization objective. Selecting only for low refusal can destroy cognitive-process, language, protocol, J-Space or off-target behavior.
material_findings.required_successor: Preregister a matched pilot using refusal/low-refusal retention plus task reasoning, DB-vs-simulation, Hyperposition, variable-N invariance, Claude re-entry, ClayCode/protocol, J-Space causal-intervention and off-target regressions.

material_findings.finding: Using the final structural/J-Space holdout to choose among abliterated checkpoints or tune abliteration strength invalidates later promotion evidence.
material_findings.required_successor: Use matched train/calibration/validation pilot surfaces for selection and keep a separately preregistered untouched holdout for promotion.

matched_pilot_requirements: same training/example budget if training is compared
final holdout unseen during candidate selection
refusal/low-refusal objective measured separately from cognition retention
Hyperposition/J-Space causal and nuisance controls retained
variable-N and DB/Claude-Code process tests retained

next_exact_action: Create one successor checkpoint-selection gate that enforces abliterated TARGET versus official CONTROL roles and exact immutable checkpoint/tokenizer/template/config manifests; freeze at least two abliterated target candidates to exact bytes; run a preregistered matched local FREE_ONLY pilot without touching the final holdout; select no winner from model-card refusal claims alone.
